+title: 'KANBAN-7: change cursor with Change.seq, root cursor, changes(after:) and RESYNC_REQUIRED on the Extras ChangeLog'
+---
+## What
+KANBAN-7 (TestudoApp/features/packages/foundationmodels-kanban.md) under EXTRAS-9 rule 9 and EXTRAS-10. Blocked on the EXTRAS-10 gate task.
+
+- Each `Change` (Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Observe/Change.swift) gets `seq: Int!` and `at: DateTime!` from `ChangeLog.append`. Keep the existing fields (updates, origin, actor, txn).
+- One `ChangeLog` per board engine. Every change goes through it: own commits, watcher batches, and transactions from a `git pull` (today `since` compares ULIDs and can miss old ones).
+- Root query `cursor: Int!` gives the seq of the state a query reads (read under the serial gate with the board). Keep `Board.cursor` too, and allow `cursor(board:)` for a related board, since kanban is multi-board.
+- `Subscription.changes(after: Int, board: String, filter: String)`: replays buffered events after `after`, then live events, in seq order, with the filter applied per subscriber. `after` too old (not in the buffer) gives `RESYNC_REQUIRED`. `after` omitted is today's behavior (live only).
+- Alias: `kanbanChanges` → `changes` in the alias table.
+- Remove the rule-9 exception from the conformance test added by the EXTRAS-9 alignment task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `{ cursor }` then `changes(after: cursor)` gives exactly the changes after the read, none lost, none repeated, including watcher and pull changes
+- [ ] Seq increases by one per Change event on a board, across own writes and watcher batches
+- [ ] A cursor that left the buffer gives `RESYNC_REQUIRED`; a cursor from before a process restart does not silently match (per the ChangeLog epoch decision)
+- [ ] `GraphQLEndpointConformance.problems` is empty with no rule-9 exception
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Read + subscribe race test: commit between the query and the subscribe is delivered
+- [ ] Watcher change (file written outside the engine) and a git-pull-style multi-transaction batch get seqs
+- [ ] Buffer overflow gives RESYNC_REQUIRED
+- [ ] Filtered subscriber still sees seq-ordered events
+- [ ] Alias `kanbanChanges` works and shows in `extensions.rewrites`
\ No newline at end of file
